description: 한국전력공사_시군구별 용도업종별 전력사용량 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전력공사. 한국전력공사에서 제공하는 시군구별 용도업종별 전력사용량 데이터로 2016년부터 2017년가지의 기간 동안 전국 시군구 단위로 전력 소비 현황을 월별·용도업종별로 정리한 자료입니다. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
